content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Motion control motors and drives for equipment makers; a component business, not engines, generator sets or fuel systems."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt plants, crushers and drills for road and mining customers; heavy equipment rather than engines or power systems."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Wood products manufacturing and lumber distribution for construction customers; an entirely different business."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Builds onsite power generation units sold to power users and sells parts and service for the same units, similar to the target."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"MRO distributor and pump repair service provider for industrial plants; it resells products rather than manufacturing engines."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Diversified group spanning utility meters, test equipment, filtration and aerospace parts; no engine or power generation overlap."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt plant manufacturer selling to paving contractors; shares OEM manufacturing and parts model but a different product and customer base."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors across diverse industries; not engines or generator sets."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, metalworking fluids and lubricants sold to plants; a chemical business, not equipment manufacturing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hardware and metal castings for equipment makers; industrial hardware rather than engines or power equipment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps and pump systems for water, fire and industrial uses; a pump business, not engines or generator sets."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Bearings and power transmission components sold to vehicle and equipment makers; a component business, not engines."}]}
